source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Paytm HDFC Bank Mobile Credit Card was rendering 15% — the highest rate in the catalogue — and 15% on rent, a category it excludes. Its base_reward_rate held 0.5 and its base rule held 0.15: a percentage written into a field that wanted a fraction. Both are now 0.005, the rule is capped at Rs.500/month and renamed so the self-consistency gate can read a number out of it, rp_value_standard is 1.00 (1 CashPoint = Re.1 against statement, already in the card's own redemption_rules), and the inert free-text 'rent payments' exclusion is now category/'rent' so the engine actually applies it, plus education. The card now reads 0.5% base and 2% on Paytm Mall/Movies/Mini App. Source: Paytm's own card FAQ. Two gate warnings cleared: no card above 10% anywhere, and no rate advertised on an excluded category.
